_comment: Microsoft files an mstsc-wine component bundle may contain (ADR-0046). Paths are relative to C:\Windows; <lang> is the display language folder (e.g. en-US). Anything not listed is rejected. Keep in sync with windows/Export-MstscComponents.ps1.

excluded.System32/devobj.dll: the runtime's builtin devobj replaces it (ADR-0004)
excluded.System32/credssp.dll: Wine's builtin CredSSP is used; the native one needs LSA infrastructure (ADR-0018)
